frame: Original GLB world frame: +Y up, +Z forward, anatomical left +X. No reflection or retargeting.

layout.positions: Flat xyz metres in joints order
layout.rotations: Flat normalized xyzw world quaternions in joints order
layout.times: Original sampler key times in seconds; closed-loop endpoint retained

semanticNotes.aliases: These aliases expose absent intermediate joints explicitly; they are not additional authored bones.
semanticNotes.hands: leftHand/rightHand map to the physical wrist joints used by target hand sockets. leftPalm/rightPalm preserve the source's further hand joints separately.
